items.title: Regular, Koszul regular, H1-regular and quasi-regular sequences agree over a Noetherian local ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a sequence in the maximal ideal of a Noetherian local ring acting on a nonzero finite module, the four notions of regular, Koszul regular, H1-regular and quasi-regular coincide, and consequently the same for sequences in the ring itself. The proof is a chain of four implications, each quoted from a named result: regularity implies Koszul regularity, Koszul regularity implies H1-regularity, H1-regularity implies quasi-regularity, and quasi-regularity over a Noetherian local ring implies regularity, closing the cycle. The final statement specialises to the module being the ring.
